# 淮安物管 zhi2-web-admin (Huai'an property-management frontend)
Frontend submodule zhi2-web-admin of the Huai'an property management platform; defects are tracked in Zentao and written back there.

## Repo and environments
- GitLab project `gitlab.zhi.com-zhi-huaian-all-wuguan-fe-zhi2-web-admin-h5-g-unlimited`; deploy-panel key `淮安物管`; local path `D:/repository/淮安物管`.
- Vite `rootDir` resolves to the parent (淮安物管), so `outDir = D:/repository/淮安物管/dist`, the exact directory nginx serves; a rebuild therefore updates the served bundle.
- 2026-11-25 registry holds only `dev` and `test` (no uat); test env listens on port 8157 and proxies the company test gateway (screenshot suffix is `-test`, so verification ran on test).
- 2026-11-25 the test account was registered in the deploy panel (none existed before): username via privacy ref `deploy_env-huaian-wuguan-test`, password resolved then injected into the panel memory cache, registration confirmed by query.
- Production site `https://wgpt.haswgzx.cn:15777/` logged in 2026-11-25 as 系统管理员; captcha is arithmetic (`4+6=?` → 10; vision once misread it as `3kBw`).
- Login pitfalls: fill account/password/captcha in one go (a failure clears all three); the login button is covered by the footer and `press` takes no selector, so focus the captcha field and press Enter; after login a forced 「消防安全温馨提醒」 dialog needs `.gate-body` (scrollHeight 906 / clientHeight 400) scrolled to the bottom.
- Plans and handoff docs live in `D:\plan\淮安物管`.

## Code locations
- General-vote detail page `src/views/autonomy/general/detail.vue`; `getDetail` comes from a mixin and `form.bizState` (a string) marks the completion state.
- Template holds two `DecisionRangeTable` (base vote-detail table and completion-state stats table) toggled by `v-if`; the fix at `detail.vue:103` adds `&& form.bizState != '2'` to the base table.
- Detail route `/{id}?formMode=view`; `getId()` in `@/utils/ruoyi.js` reads the last path segment, so `?id=` triggers 「请求参数格式错误」.
- List API `/api/v2.0/autonomy/decision/page` requires `decisionType` (`NORMAL` general vote, `OPTION` option vote); manual fetch needs `Admin-Token` from sessionStorage.
- Navigation: `/autonomy` entry, general votes `#/autonomy/ownerdecision/general`, option votes `#/autonomy/ownerdecision/option`; the 「更多功能」 panel is a hover-triggered `more-menu-trigger`.

## Build and verification
- Builds must run in the background and be polled (orchestrator caps at 180s); on 2026-11-25 the background build finished exit 0 in 113s and rewrote the served dist, also regenerating `public/version.json` and `sprite.svg` (pre-existing dirty files along with `report.html`, never committed). eslint is still blocked by a gate and recorded as not run.
- Production has total=0 NORMAL records so the fix cannot be verified there; the only `bizState='2'` production record is option vote `decisionId=2080196709820981248` (`TPBJ20260723000005` 「公共设施维修」, vote finished/recorded), whose detail page has no 「表决明细」 block.
- Test env holds 3 completion-state (bizState=2) NORMAL records; after the rebuild all three detail pages show exactly one 「表决明细」 block (two before), with evidence `detail-single-block-20261125-102830.png` and full page `detail-full-20261125-103300.png` (1256×2300).
- Zentao 6522 attachment (test env) showed two 「表决明细」 blocks for record `TPBJ20260902000001`, topic `11`, area 「测试20260827」, status 「表决完成」.

## Tasks and relations
- Handled Zentao bug 6522 (duplicate data on general-vote detail); root cause and fix recorded in zentao_bug_6522.
- New requirement 「完成态基本信息置顶」 (caused by global `index.scss:256` `column-reverse`) recorded in entity 完成态基本信息置顶.
- Chain hop1→hop2→hop3 handoff doc and schedule recorded in zentao_6522_handoff_hop3.
